title: Faber — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Faber.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Italian Ventilation." Specialty tier. Faber has been making range hoods in Italy since 1955 — one of the worlds largest hood manufacturers. Now part of Franke Group. Known for innovative designs and strong extraction power.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Faber:

• Italian manufacturing since 1955

• One of the worlds largest hood manufacturers

• Franke Group engineering

• Innovative designs and strong extraction

• Perimetric suction technology
